title: Angry Chick Wizard
description: A small yellow chick with an angry expression stands in a white martial arts robe and headband, casting a glowing orange magical orb. A large blue dragonfly perches on its head while the chick holds a glowing staff. The scene is set on a nighttime rooftop with glowing lanterns, city buildings, and a crescent moon in a purple sky.
prompt: A fierce yellow chick wearing a white martial arts gi and headband stands on a glowing tiled rooftop at night, casting a bright orange magical orb with one hand while holding a glowing staff in the other. A large detailed blue dragonfly rests on its head. Traditional Japanese lanterns hang from surrounding dark buildings under a purple night sky with a crescent moon, dramatic lighting, cinematic atmosphere.
